AFFIDAVIT OF FACTS CONCERNING THE IDENTITY OF HEIRS
STATE OF TEXAS
COUNTY OF HIDALGO
Before me, the undersigned authority, personally appeared Eva Maria Mireles ("Affiant"), who, being duly
sworn, states:
1. Affiant. My name is Eva Maria Mireles. My residence address is 6001 Troy Ave, Weslaco, TX 78599. I am
the daughter-in-law of José Guadalupe Berrones and knew him and his family for approximately 30 years. I am
personally familiar with his family and marital history and have personal knowledge of the facts stated in this
affidavit.
2. Decedent. José Guadalupe Berrones ("Decedent") died on August 4, 2015, at Knapp Medical Center.
His residence at the time of death was 2009 Dallas Dr, Weslaco, TX 78596.
3. Will. Decedent died without a will.
4. Surviving Spouse. Decedent was married to San Juana Ginez Berrones, who survived him. Her residence
address is 2009 Dallas Dr, Weslaco, TX 78596.

none
